speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID)

The combination of severe lower abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, dysuria, and a history of inconsistent condom use with a new partner is highly suggestive of a pelvic infection. Given your age and sexual history, I am concerned about gonorrhea or chlamydia leading to PID. This diagnosis is supported by your elevated white blood cell count and ESR, which indicate significant inflammation.
